assets.use: The logo mark in every email's header, shown at 44x44 (brand.json logo). Drawn from assets/src/logo.svg by `npm run images`. Replace it with the user's mark: a square PNG at twice the size it's shown, readable on light and dark backgrounds.
Source of assets/images/logo.png (the sample Pebblework mark). Emails never use the SVG itself: most mail apps don't show SVG.
The newsletter's header picture, shown 600x273 across the top of the card. Drawn from assets/src/newsletter-hero.svg.
Source of assets/images/newsletter-hero.png: pebbles balanced next to a weekly planner.
The product-update email's picture, shown 528x280 inside the card. Drawn from assets/src/product-update.svg.
Source of assets/images/product-update.png: a task card that repeats every week.
The parcel in the order-shipped email, shown 120x120 on a transparent background (it sits on the card in light and dark mode). Drawn from assets/src/parcel.svg.
Source of assets/images/parcel.png: a parcel tied with string.
